decisions.reason: The plug-ins extend the firm's established data integration offer and already have a dedicated page, so with a growing industry and the slack of a 190-person firm there is no shortfall that would prompt search for other uses of the resources.
The building digital twin service is only mentioned on the website, so its results are uncertain, but it builds on the core offer and the firm has enough slack and growth to carry it a while longer.
The authentication delegation service is close to the core business and low-cost to maintain, although it overlaps with the more prominently launched Identity Service and could be merged into it.
An open GIS application development framework fits the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and its standards work, so it likely meets aspirations as a strategic platform component.

The Identity Service was actively announced as enabling seamless integration of GeoIT applications, which signals management commitment and results that meet aspirations in a market with growing security needs.
